Subject : Empanelment of advocates - regarding.
Reference : Head office letter No. LC-7(72)2017/Merger/ 12019 dated 7.9.2017
Sir,

Please refer to Head office letter referred above vide which it was directed that wherever
the CGITs are located in places where High Court is also available, an advocate from the High
Court panel may be selected to defend Tribunal cases also. It was further mentioned that in

case, there is no High Court in the locality of Tribunal, fresh panel for the concemed Tribunal
may be constituted by the concerned Zonal ACGs.

2. In this connection, it is further informed that the same analogy may be followed for
CAT, DCDRE, SCDRF, NCDRC, District Courts and Lower Courts also ie. in places wherever
High Court is available , the advocates from the High Court panel may be selected for the above
Courts/Forums also . In case, there is no High Court in the locality of these Courts/Forums,
fresh panel for the concemed Court/Forum may be constituted by the concerned Zonal ACCs.

(This issues with the approval of CPFC.)
